definitions.recovered: the top-ranked solution equals the true plaintext
definitions.truthInTop20: the true plaintext is among the 20 best distinct solutions returned
definitions.otherHigher: the top solution differs from the truth AND scores higher than the truth under the solver objective (5-gram joint score + entropy penalty 0.5 + 1.0 x wordSegment log10 P)
definitions.otherHigherWords: the top solution differs from the truth AND has a higher wordSegment log10 P than the truth
definitions.englishLike: the top solution segments into dictionary words only (0 unknown words, common vocabulary)
definitions.enumerateBetter: (simple-substitution set only) number of distinct consistent strings of <=4 words from the top 10,000 words of data/lm/words_common.tsv whose wordSegment log10 P is at least the truth's, excluding the truth (a lower bound: more words or a larger list only add fits)

solver.iters: auto (<=20000 with the inner word term)
